notes: A born-digital Greek physics thesis on GATE/GEANT4 PET simulation. The catalogue title does not match the content, but the labels read the print correctly. Most of the Latin lines are GATE macro commands in sans or monospace type (1-18), with letter-spaced capital comment headers (22-35) labelled without the inter-letter spaces, which is the usual target. The Greek body lines (7-10, 37-40) are exact, and the anomalies are genre (code, letter-spacing), not label errors. Small slips: line 5 inserts a space in 'setOutFileSingles ThresholderFlag', and line 36 reads the Latin axis 'y' as Greek 'γ'.
